item.title: A startup wants to build a massive nuclear-powered data center on public land in Utah

item.title: Aga's restaurant in Houston is number one in the world for Uber Eats deliveries
item.description: In Houston, Aga's Indian-Pakistani restaurant serves around 4,000 meals a day and according to Uber Eats, it has the most takeout orders in the world on the their platform.
